mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish starting with clear skies and 54 degrees near Verona City Hall. The overnight low will drop to 45 degrees with no rain predicted, and air quality is currently elevated at 76. Tonight features a Waxing Gibbous moon, and early tomorrow at 5:45 AM, look west toward Mount Horeb to see the space station travel toward Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

In city news, Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving forward with gravel base installation and concrete work on Todd Street. Additionally, the City of Verona is promoting its residential toilet rebate program and providing contour maps to help homeowners design yard rain gardens.

For upcoming events, you can test your knowledge today with Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow brings a busy evening with Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, ART House 360 kicks off its Thursday night community series this week.

In law enforcement updates, on Thursday afternoon, Verona Police arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace. Alcohol was ruled out as a factor, and fortunately no injuries were reported.
To finish up, Culver's is featuring Devil's Food Cake as today's flavor of the day. The restaurant is open until 10:00 PM and closing soon, so head over shortly to grab your scoop.
